uncited: *   **Time Complexity:** Significantly faster than standard front-to-back volume rendering because it terminates early.
The loop breaks after finding the primary object (if high density/opacity) or after finding the primary and one background object.
*   **When to use:** When performance is critical and a stylized, non-photorealistic look is desired.
*   **When not to use:** When physically accurate volume visualization is required.
Exact Projection Full Opacity is described in the context of illustrative and non-photorealistic volume rendering.
